description: Return where a project's traffic comes from: the marketing channels with their shares and the leading social platforms with their shares of the social traffic. Before a reveal only the three leading channels and the three leading social platforms are returned, as bands: a full channel mix is close to a fingerprint and would identify the site without paying for it; after a reveal every channel and platform in the data is returned, and precision: exact returns exact shares instead of bands. Costs the base price plus the channels price for every project whose channels your organization does not already hold, and with precision: exact a surcharge for every revealed project on every call; a project without a channels layer comes back with profile null and is charged neither the part nor the exact surcharge. Ask in bands first, and for exact values only when your user needs exact numbers.

estimate.description: When true, run the query but return only its composition, price and a quote_token instead of data

precision.description: band (default) or exact; exact applies only to revealed projects, adds a surcharge for each of them, and is otherwise ignored with a note

quote_token.description: Execute a previous estimate: pass the quote_token instead of the query parameters

refs.description: Projects to describe; refused above batch.get_channels in capabilities; required unless quote_token is given

items.description: Opaque project id as returned by this server to your organization

name: get_channels
